analysis_kind: retrospective arithmetic on existing measurements; no simulation or benchmark run

source.commit_note: Integrated local artifact identified by SHA256; no published commit asserted for this file.

formula: For each variant and stage, median across the seven saved repetitions of timing[stage]/timing[total]. Stage medians need not sum to one; uninstrumented overhead exists.
workload: Development seed 4301, N=16, duration=1 second, 400 physics steps, 100 field updates, recording disabled
interpretation: The lean measurement is approximately 50.6% physics and 17.6% field. It does not establish a universal bottleneck or causal decomposition of speedup. Timed nested counters and host/JIT effects are possible.
